summary.text: Tanya Flanagan, listed by the Nevada Legislature as Tanya P. Flanagan, is a Democratic Assemblymember for District 7 in Clark County, first elected in November 2024. She sat on the Education, Government Affairs, and Revenue committees in the 2025 session and works in communications and public relations.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Flanagan was born in McNary, Arizona, in 1970 and earned a B.A. in journalism and political science from the University of Arizona in 1993 and an executive M.B.A. from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, in 2006.
Her page lists past work as a reporter and editor at the Las Vegas Sentinel-Voice and as a KUNV radio talk show host.
She serves on the Assembly Health and Wellness Committee.
